name: Manual tests (people + real phones)
how: Run on a real phone, then log the result on this page.

cases.title: Grandparent finds the newest photo and comments
cases.steps: Hand your phone to a grandparent with the prototype open as their name. Ask them to find the newest photo and leave a comment. Don't help.
cases.expected: Done in under a minute with no help.

cases.title: Someone can tell who sees a post
cases.steps: Show an adult one of your posts. Ask: who can see this?
cases.expected: They answer correctly from the screen alone.

cases.title: Larger text is readable at arm's length
cases.steps: As a grandparent, turn on Larger text in Me. Hold the phone at arm's length.
cases.expected: Captions and comments readable without glasses (or with their usual pair).

cases.title: New circle end to end
cases.steps: Make a circle, add 2 people, share a photo only to it, then switch Viewing as to someone outside it.
cases.expected: Only the 2 people see it; the outsider sees nothing.

cases.title: Install from TestFlight link on iPhone
cases.steps: Open the TestFlight public link on an iPhone that has never had Hearth.
cases.expected: Installed and signed in by text link in under 3 minutes. Blocked until build #1.

cases.title: iPhone to Android photo arrives full quality
cases.steps: Post from an iPhone to a circle with an Android grandparent who chose Text message link.
cases.expected: Text arrives within a minute; photo opens sharp, not an MMS thumbnail.

cases.title: 60-second video over cellular
cases.steps: On cellular (Wi-Fi off), share a 60s video.
cases.expected: Uploads in under 30s and plays on an older phone.

cases.title: Location removed from photos
cases.steps: Share a photo taken with location on. Download it on another phone and check its info.
cases.expected: No GPS location in the file.

cases.title: Removed person loses access on their own phone
cases.steps: Remove someone from a circle while they have the post open.
cases.expected: Gone for them within 10 minutes; they can't reopen it.

cases.title: Co-parent separation with real accounts
cases.steps: Two real households. Co-parent opens every screen.
cases.expected: They never see the other side's circles, relatives, or posts not shared with them.

cases.title: Email digest arrives and links work
cases.steps: Set a tester to Daily email digest; post 2 photos.
cases.expected: One email that evening; links open the right photos.

cases.title: BETA-BULK-1/7 Bulk pick keeps the date taken (Expo Go)
cases.steps: In Expo Go, bulk-pick 20 photos from 2 trips: one abroad, one Live Photo, one HEIC, one screenshot with no date. Send to a test group. Open By date.
cases.expected: Each photo sits under the month and day it was taken (the abroad one on its local day); the screenshot sorts by today. If Expo Go returns no EXIF date, stop and report (plan stop rule).

cases.title: BETA-BULK-4/7 Bulk send survives no network, then network
cases.steps: Bulk-pick 48 photos. Tap Send, then turn on airplane mode at about 'Sending 12 of 48'. Force-quit. Wait 1 minute, turn airplane mode off, reopen Hearth.
cases.expected: It finishes on its own: 48 photos in the right posts, none twice. The other phone gets 1 notice. A downloaded copy has no location.

cases.title: BETA-AUD-17 Share sheet: Everyone first, then Groups, then Events
cases.steps: On Chase's iPhone, Chase and then Danielle each share one photo to Everyone and one to the Charleston trip. Then ask each: who sees this one?
cases.expected: Everyone is first and takes 1 tap; Groups then Events follow, each as name plus 'N people'; both answer 'who sees this?' correctly from the screen alone (2 of 2).

cases.title: BETA-AUD-22 Make an event unaided (milestone 4)
cases.steps: Ask Chase to make 'Thanksgiving 2026' by ticking groups and households. Time it. Don't help.
cases.expected: Under 60 seconds; it shows under Events in the share sheet as name plus 'N people'; the screen says everyone in it can read each other's comments on its photos.

cases.title: BETA-JOIN-5 Still signed in after 7 days
cases.steps: Sign in, then don't open Hearth for 7 days. Open it.
cases.expected: Photos open straight away; no new code asked for.

cases.title: BETA-NOTIFY-1 Notices arrive within a minute
cases.steps: As B, comment on 10 posts over 2 days. Note when each notice arrives (the Help screen's timing log, AE-10).
cases.expected: 9 of 10 arrive within 1 minute.

cases.title: BETA-JOIN-2 Sign in with the 6-digit email code
cases.steps: Sign in with your email; type the 6-digit code from the email.
cases.expected: In within a minute; no password.

cases.title: BETA-JOIN-1 Account B joins with the Test house code
cases.steps: As account B, tap 'I have an invite code' and type the Test house code.
cases.expected: B joins and sees only Everyone and Test house posts.

cases.title: BETA-SHARE-1 Post 3 photos to Test house in 3 taps or fewer
cases.steps: Post 3 photos to 'Test house'.
cases.expected: At the top of your Photos right away; B sees all 3 within a minute.

cases.title: BETA-SEE-3 Full screen with buttons
cases.steps: As B: tap a photo, use Next/Back, then Close.
cases.expected: Full screen; buttons work, not just swipes.

cases.title: BETA-AUD-1 A post to Gammy's house never reaches B
cases.steps: Post 1 photo to 'Gammy's house' only.
cases.expected: B never sees it.

cases.title: BETA-SHARE-4 Airplane mode, then network
cases.steps: Turn on airplane mode, post, turn it off.
cases.expected: It sends on its own.

cases.title: BETA-REPLY-3 / NOTIFY-4 Comment and heart send one email notice
cases.steps: As B: comment and heart.
cases.expected: You get one email notice.

cases.title: M-09 / BETA-SEE-5 Save to phone, no location
cases.steps: Save a photo to your phone; check its info in Photos.
cases.expected: It's there at 2048 px with no location.

cases.title: Gate: 10+ posts over 2 days, 0 lost (QA-3)
cases.steps: Keep posting until 10+ posts over 2 days, then run backend/scripts/sent-vs-received.sh (MILESTONE-1.md).
cases.expected: RESULT: sent N, received N, lost 0; 0 crash reports.

cases.title: BETA-BULK-1 fallback: a screenshot gets its date
cases.steps: Bulk-pick a screenshot (no EXIF date) with 2 normal photos.
cases.expected: The screenshot sits under the day it was taken, not undated.
